networkAccess.reasoning: Bridge reads design token files from the team's GitHub repository through the GitHub REST API (api.github.com) and opens pull requests with the designer's variable changes, or issues for component requests. After a push of token values it asks the Bridge site (bridge.floriangouloubi.com, POST /api/ship) to ship that pull request once its checks pass. "Sign in with Bridge" gets a one-time code from the same site (POST /api/plugin-link) and polls until the designer picks their team. "Ask Claude to fix it" asks the same site (/api/claude) to run Claude on a component for the team and reads where it stands. Optionally, when a designer adds their own Anthropic API key, the plugin calls api.anthropic.com to draft the text of a request. The key stays in figma.clientStorage on that computer; without a key, no request goes to Anthropic.
